title: Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Massachusetts to distribute chip-enabled EBT cards statewide in August to combat benefit fraud and theft.
State is the fourth in the U.S. to adopt chip-and-tap technology for EBT benefits, after a pilot in Worcester.
Nearly 1 million residents use EBT cards, with $2.6 billion in SNAP benefits distributed annually in Massachusetts.

title: Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston City Hall now offers pet certificates to couples who wed there, allowing pets to be recognized in the union.
Mayor Michelle Wu announced the pet certificate program, celebrating pets' roles in family bonds and household unions.
The first pet certificate was issued to a couple and their dog, Bono, acknowledging him as a 'true Pawstonian'.

title: Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Kevin Nealon discusses his comedic inspirations and New England roots ahead of shows in Boston and Portsmouth.
Nealon's social media presence, including playful interactions with Conan O'Brien, helps promote his new special 'Loose in the Crotch'.
His YouTube series 'Hiking with Kevin' features interviews with celebrities, combining fitness and comedy.

title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox catcher Willson Contreras was hit by a 95 MPH fastball from Dodgers' Will Klein in the head.
Contreras initially stayed in the game but was taken out for 'precautionary reasons' in the next inning.
Manager Chad Tracy stated tests so far are fine, but they're monitoring Contreras for potential concussion symptoms.

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech as assistant wide receivers coach after Patriots training camp stint.
Hopkins, 34, praised for leadership and offensive knowledge by Georgia Tech head coach David Key.
Hopkins's move to coaching puts his NFL playing career on hold but not officially retired.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Patriots wide receivers Efton Chism and Kyle Williams compete for spots on the 53-man roster during training camp.
Chism impressed with strong preseason performances, but concerns exist over potentially losing him if placed on the practice squad.
Williams rebounded in training camp, showcasing talent that could secure his roster position amid strong competition.

title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: George Springer is interested in a potential trade to the Boston Red Sox, despite his eight-team no-trade list.
The Red Sox are reportedly considering acquiring Miami Marlins infielder Xavier Edwards for infield depth.
Springer, currently with Toronto, is having a down season batting .234 with 12 homers in 78 games.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' streams on Hulu, featuring Meryl Streep and Anne Hathaway at a troubled Runway magazine.
'The Drama' with Zendaya and Robert Pattinson is a dark comedy on HBO Max exploring social norms and cancel culture.
'Furious' Season 1 on Hulu follows rookie FBI agent Alice Black in a thrilling hunt for a serial killer.

title: Here’s how home, away broadcasts reacted to Jarren Duran’s on-field flare-up
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox's Jarren Duran criticized for on-field reaction involving teammate Willson Contreras and coach Chad Epperson during a game.
NESN and WEEI broadcasters expressed confusion and disdain for Duran's actions, highlighting his frustration with Epperson's decisions.
Red Sox considering trading Duran ahead of MLB trade deadline amid ongoing team tension and player's visible frustration.

title: Drake Maye on building chemistry with A.J. Brown: ‘I am not going to shy away from him.’
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye and A.J. Brown are developing on-field chemistry during Patriots training camp in Foxborough.
Maye targeted Brown frequently in recent practices, completing most passes including a notable redzone play.
Both players emphasize communication, aiming to improve connection for the upcoming NFL season with Patriots.
